verdict.rationale: Insomnia is documented as an API client with MCP client support (discovering/invoking external MCP servers) and can connect to Kong Konnect for mocking/validating requests, but there is no evidence it acts as a proxy/gateway that governs LLM or MCP traffic with token limits, prompt guards, or provider routing — those capabilities belong to Kong's separate AI Gateway/Konnect product, not Insomnia itself.
